item.scp_unleashed.scp860_key.tooltip: A heavy old key of deep blue metal. It is cool to the touch.
item.scp_unleashed.scp860_key.detail: It has never once been warm, not even in a closed hand.
block.scp_unleashed.scp860_door.tooltip: An old plank door set in a band of small weathered stones. There is a keyhole.
block.scp_unleashed.scp860_door.detail: There is a smell of rain and moss behind it.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp860.0: A man in a pinstriped suit brings the key and its door himself.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp860.1: He did not leave a card. He did not need to.
message.scp_unleashed.scp860.key_stuck: The key will not turn back.
jade.scp_unleashed.scp860_door.keyed: A blue key rests in the lock
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp860_key.1: SCP-860-1 is a heavy key of deep blue metal. It belongs to an old plank door set in a band of weathered stone.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp860_key.2: Use the key on the door to set it in the lock, then open the door to see where it leads. Sneak and use an empty hand to take the key back.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp860_key.3: It cannot be crafted. Recover the SCP-860 dossier from an Archive Terminal and break its seal. A well-dressed stranger brings the key and its door in person.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp860_door.1: An old plank door in a band of small weathered stones. It needs open ground one block wide and two tall.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp860_door.2: Without its key it will not open. While anyone walks beyond it, neither the door nor its key can be disturbed.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp860_2_spawn_eg: SCP-860-2 is a lean, long-eared creature with wood-grained skin, glowing eyes and curling gold markings. It lives among the trees beyond the door.
Away from its forest it keeps its distance and watches. It does not like to be crowded, and it does not forget a blow.

dossier.scp_unleashed.860.title: Blue Key
dossier.scp_unleashed.860.caption: SCP-860-1 at intake, resting on the threshold of the door it was recovered with.
dossier.scp_unleashed.860.page.0.title: Special Containment Procedures:
dossier.scp_unleashed.860.page.0.text.0: SCP-860-1 is kept in a locked key safe in a low-security storage wing. It is not to leave the wing without written approval from the site director.
dossier.scp_unleashed.860.page.0.text.1: The door recovered with SCP-860-1 is stored upright in a separate room, with its stone frame intact. The key and the door are not to be kept in the same room.
dossier.scp_unleashed.860.page.0.text.2: Personnel returning from an authorised test are to be debriefed at once, and the area in front of the door is to be kept clear for one hour afterwards.
dossier.scp_unleashed.860.page.1.title: Description:
dossier.scp_unleashed.860.page.1.text.0: SCP-860-1 is a key roughly twelve centimetres long, made of an unidentified metal with a deep blue colour. It is always cool to the touch. It shows no wear, and no tool has been able to mark it.
dossier.scp_unleashed.860.page.1.text.1: When SCP-860-1 is turned in the lock of its door and the door is opened, the doorway no longer leads to the space behind it. Through it can be seen a forest under heavy fog, and a narrow dirt path leading away between the trees.
dossier.scp_unleashed.860.page.1.text.2: Nothing carried through the door arrives in the forest. Returning personnel find their belongings exactly as they left them. The forest is never the same twice. Teams entering together walk the same paths.
dossier.scp_unleashed.860.page.1.text.3: The forest is inhabited. SCP-860-2 refers to one or more creatures seen moving among the trees: lean and long-eared, with wood-grained skin, glowing eyes and curling gold markings. They are rarely seen clearly. They are almost always watching.
dossier.scp_unleashed.860.page.2.title: Addendum 860-1: Exploration Log
dossier.scp_unleashed.860.page.2.text.0: Agent %rHollis%r entered the forest wearing a body camera. The footage is grey with fog throughout.
dossier.scp_unleashed.860.page.2.text.1: "It's quiet. Fog everywhere. The path goes on a long way and splits now and then. Something in the ferns keeps pace with me. I can see its eyes sometimes."
dossier.scp_unleashed.860.page.2.text.2: "I stopped to get my bearings. The rustling got closer the longer I stood there. I didn't like it. I kept walking."
dossier.scp_unleashed.860.page.2.text.3: Agent %rHollis%r reached a second door, standing on its own among the trees, and stepped through it. He came back out of the door he had entered by. He could not say how long he had been gone.
dossier.scp_unleashed.860.page.3.title: Addendum 860-2: Incident Log
dossier.scp_unleashed.860.page.3.text.0: During test 860-07, Agent %rMarsh%r came back through the door at a run. Something came through behind her.
dossier.scp_unleashed.860.page.3.text.1: The creature, now designated SCP-860-2-A, was contained on site with considerable difficulty. It is kept in a wooded enclosure, where it watches its handlers from the far side and has injured two personnel who came too close.
dossier.scp_unleashed.860.page.3.text.2: Agent %rMarsh%r has declined all further tests. %rShe will not talk about the walk back.%r
dossier.scp_unleashed.860.page.4.title: Addendum 860-3: Provenance
dossier.scp_unleashed.860.page.4.text: SCP-860-1 has no recovery record. It was delivered, with its door, to a reader of this file. See field notes.
